-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_EDS_TRU_BASEMST','EDS','EDS','TRU_BASEMST','TRU',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2';GO
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST','EDS_STG','D360','STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST','TRU',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2';GO


-----insert data in om task dependency table 
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST','TSK_EDS_TRU_BASEMST',NULL; GO


select * from om.om_tasks where task_name in ('TSK_EDS_TRU_BASEMST','TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST')

select * from om.om_task_dependency where task_name in ('TSK_EDS_TRU_BASEMST','TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST')
